attribution.finding: Three numbered endings with default repeat counts produce MuseScore pitches 72,76,72,67,72,72 versus MNX Lab 72,76,72,67. Both source encodings have uncounted backward repeats. attribution.evidence: Three imported volta endings and two endRepeat values of 2; the raw MIDI and paired MNX retain the disagreement. No convention change is inferred solely from tool output.
